transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Try to avoid heavy work for 1 month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for that information. My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it is safe to continue using them unless you were told otherwise. If you are running out, your GP should be able to provide more. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Okay, that sounds good. I'm also wondering, I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended: A bit of light sensitivity can be normal as the eye adjusts to the new lens. If it is mild and things just seem brighter, wear sunglasses outside. But if it is severe, or you have pain and a red eye, that is not normal and we may need to check it. Do you have any other questions?
transcript.delivered: A bit of light sensitivity can be normal as the eye adjusts to the new lens.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, one last thing. Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after the operation. It should improve quickly and settle down over time. If it’s still blurry, or getting worse, it may need checking. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I don't have any more questions. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, you've answered all my questions. Thank you!

verdict.label: fail
